whatDidYouDo: What did you work on today?
textPlaceholder: e.g. Worked 6 hours. Handled customer support, resolved 12 requests and prepared a daily report.
strengthensHint: This entry can strengthen this skill once you confirm it
freeTextLead: Describe work or activity freely: quantities, units, time, location, and notes. The system will suggest a structure, but it only becomes a fact once you confirm it.
example1: Worked 6 hours, helped customers, and handled 12 requests.
example2: Prepared a client proposal and aligned the project plan.
example3: Assembled furniture, cleaned the work area, and handed over the result.
example4: Led a team, assigned tasks, and checked the result.
suggestionReviewIntro: These are suggestions. Confirm only what is correct. Unconfirmed suggestions are not saved as facts.
savedBody: Your confirmed details were added to your work history.
pilotBackboneNote: Pilot release: your entries are private right now. The manager / client confirmation + audit layer is still being prepared — when it ships, we'll enable it on the same entry with no extra action from you.
quantitySummaryHint: Optional quick summary — you can also write all quantities and units in the description above.
classifyLater: Later, the system can suggest work direction, skills, quantities, and units from your entry. Suggestions must be reviewed before becoming facts.
connectsLater: This entry can later connect to skills and confirmations

entry.deleteConfirm: Really delete this entry? It becomes soft-deleted — the row stays in history but won't show in the list.
entry.deleteBlocked: Entry already confirmed — send a correction request instead of deleting.

editEntryBanner: You're editing a saved entry. Suggest the structure again, confirm what you're changing, then "Update entry" replaces the old version. To back out —

result.notAuthorized: You are not allowed to review this entry.
result.reviewNotEnabled: Review is not enabled for this worker yet.

noEngagement: You don't have an active work engagement yet, so there is nothing to log against. Once a manager or client adds you to an organization or project, your journal opens here.
saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
notesRequiredCopy: Describe what you worked on — the free text is the proof of record.
foundSummary: The system found {times} time entries and {activities} possible work directions. Confirm only what is true below.
reviewMetaNote: Private entry · suggestions reviewed by you. Manager / client confirmation will be added later.

fragment.unknownHint: The system recognised a duration but not the work itself. Add a short description — the label stays private until a human confirmation step is added.
fragment.unknownClarifyPrompt: Enter a short label so this fragment can be confirmed. Without a clarification it will stay unexplained in the list.
fragment.unresolvedUnknownsBanner: {count} fragment(s) still need a clarification. You can save the entry without them, but adding a label helps anyone reviewing this entry later understand the context.

self_progress.awaitingHint: These skills have no confirmed journal entries yet. Add an entry that mentions the relevant work — suggestions will appear here, and your confirmations will build the evidence base.
self_progress.title: You have {n} skills
